UserProfileDoc.title: UserProfileDoc
UserProfileDoc.description: Private profile metadata for a 99Pay wallet owner.

ownerId.description: Firebase Auth UID of the profile owner.

fullName.description: Display name of the wallet owner.

phoneNumber.description: Phone number for local mobile money linking.

createdAt.description: Server timestamp when profile was created.

updatedAt.description: Server timestamp when profile was last updated.

EncryptedVaultDoc.description: Client-side AES-256-GCM encrypted 99Pay wallet backup blob.

ciphertext.description: Base64 AES-256-GCM encrypted wallet JSON payload.

itemCount.description: Total number of encrypted items inside the backup.
